rationale: The text describes connecting data and workloads and enabling data collaboration, but remains broad marketing language without enough concrete conventional software operation to support a non-AI label; the negative is weak and forced.
evidence_spans: A single, global platform that powers the Data Cloud.
Snowflake is uniquely designed to connect businesses globally, across any type or scale of data and many different workloads, and unlock seamless data collaboration.
conflict_response: The labeler flags the broad marketing framing, while the blind proposal treated data connection and collaboration as sufficient conventional functionality. The exact text does describe those conventional-sounding purposes but does not provide a concrete operation or AI signal, so this reconciliation preserves the concern as weak and forced rather than upgrading the negative to supported.
